title: Guitar to Flute
quoteHighlight: Naa efforts undali ani flute nerchukuntunna neekosamm! 🎶
content:
Neeku istamaina guitar nerchukundham anukunnaaa… gaani budget and time constraints valla avvaledhu.

But naa efforts undali ani… flute nerchukuntunna neekosamm! 🎶
Emo, inka antha perfect avvaledhu, but still putting efforts. Chala ayyayi, sarigga time ivvalekapoya…

Emo, maybe peddha matter kakapovachu nerchukovadam, but naaku chala peddha record… nenu musical instrument nerchukovadam!

I am a guy who is over ambitious… but efforts entha pedathano thelusu kadha neeku? 🥺🤍

title: Registered in Mind
quoteHighlight: Neeku istamayinavi chepthey, ala mind lo register aypothayi… ✨
content:
Elagoo marchipotha… anni observe cheyadam raadhu.

But after I met you, I changed myself as you like. Neeku observation istam… nee gurinchi em topic vachinaa, I put my 1000% focus! 🧠✨

Neeku istamayinavi chepthey, ala mind lo register aypothayi… even small details:
• Photos istam 📸
• Music istam 🎵
• AC padadhu ❄️
• Modern kante traditions istam 🥻
• Chocolates ante baagaa istam 🍫
…inkaa chalaaaa!

title: Becoming Your Dream Person

Nuvvu oohinchukunna person ki em qualities undalo, anni naalo undali ani try chesthunna.

Maybe physical qualities I cannot match… but other than that, I can and I will! 🤍💫

Nuvvu premaga or konchem care chupinchinaa… naaku face lo 10,000 Watts bulb velugudhiii! 💡✨

title: Mood Controller & The Rain
quoteHighlight: You are my mood controller… my entire world depends on youuu 🌧️☕
content:
Neetho evaranna close aithe possessiveness… daani kante bhayam, like dhooram aypothavemo ani. 🥺

Nuvvu navvithe ikkada full happy… akkada neeku health problem ante ikkada same pain, mentally. Like, you are my mood controller… my entire world depends on youuu.

Neetho video call matladithe adho achievement… ninnu choosthu undipothaa, neeku kooda thelusu. Nuvvu 'Nandhuu' ante inka rathrulu nidralu undavu… coffee kante ekkuva effective! ☕

Nee varsham pichi entha pattasindhi ante… ala thadusthunna nuvve gurthosthunnav. Neeku istamainadhi edhanna naaku istam… 🌧️🤍

title: Every Bucketlist & Dream
quoteHighlight: Every bucketlist, every dream fulfill chese duty nenu theesukovali… 🥺
content:
Naaku nuvvu eppudu chalaaa happy gaa, eppudu navvuthu, nannu thiduthuuu… neeku nachinattu gaa, every bucketlist, every dream fulfill chese duty nenu theesukovali ani undhi. 🥺

Like nee ambitions naavi… marriage chesukuni chalaaaa baaga choosukovali ani undhi. Chala nights spend cheyali, chala vacations, chala foods… chala godavalu (not serious, just silly!).

Every time ninnu bujjaginchali, impress cheyali… nee alaka istam. Ninnu ninnu laage istapadda… verega maarali, idhi marchukovali ani asalu ananu… endhukante alage istam naaku, chalaa istamey! 🤍✨

title: My Soo What Soulmate
quoteHighlight: You are my soo what soulmate 🕊️🤍
content:
Nuvvu unte vere person ane thought kooda ledhu naaku.

Eppudu aithe nuvvu vachavo… inko ammayi face kooda gurthu ledhu, choodaledhu, choodalenu kooda!

Eppudu aithe naku feelings unnayi anukunnano… akkade na prapancham aagipoyindhi, neetho kalisina prapancham start ayyindhi. Everything that happens, or every thought I have, belongs to you and my family…

You are my soo what soulmate. 🕊️🤍

title: Prayers & Becoming Worthy
quoteHighlight: Kaavali ani devudini konni velaaa sarlu korukunnaaa… 💔
content:
Nee valla edchaaa… 🥺
Kaavali ani devudini konni velaaa sarlu korukunnaaa… nathooo undali anii.

Jarugudho, isthado, ledho… ledha inka ninnu pondhe worth inka raakapovachu. But I will never give up… worthy gaa maaratha!

Asalu nee value, nuvvu entha istamo… neeku vere vallu close avuthunnappudu ardham ayyindhi. Nannu distance pettadam… appati nunchi thelisindhi nee value, nuvvu ante entha istamo… 💔

title: Vulnerability & Fear
quoteHighlight: Dhooram pettina prathi saariii, inkaa ekkuva deep ga love chesesthunna… 🥺
content:
Naa kopam kooda choosavu first time… adhi kooda nee meedha kaadhu, vellipothavemo ane bhayam tho burst ayina possessiveness choosavu.

Mandipothundhi… like ela untadhi ante, nuvvu chepthunte 'nuvvu natho kooda entha excitement tho matladithe bagundu, natho unnappudu entha happy ga undali' ani chala anukunta.

Tharuvatha neeku nachatledhu ani thelisi distance pedadham, dhooranga undham, aapedham anukunna… gaani chaalaa kashtam aypoyindhe!

Dhooram pettina prathi saariii, inkaa ekkuva deep ga love chesesthunna… give up ivvalekapothunna. Nuvvu dhooram pedithe undalenu… enni sarlu 'veedu vaddhu anna paduthunnadu' ani anukovachu… 🥺💔

title: First Choice

Oka chance pogottukovali ani ledhu naaku… anthaaa istammm! Neetho na lifetime undali ani undhi.

Kaani ee madhya ardham ayyindhi… emmo nijamo kaadho thelidhu. Entha try chesina, em chesina, nenu nachuthunnana ani doubt vasthundhi…
Eppatiki nachana? Nuvvu korukune person nenu eppatiki kaanaaa? 🥺

Nenu nee first choice eppatiki kaana?
I want to beee yourrr firsttt choice… 🤍

title: I Don't Want To Force You

Naaku ninnu neeku nachinattu gaa unchali ani korika… appudu nenu force cheyakoodadhu gaa.

But eppudanna low ayina, eppudanna confidence thaggina, evaranna wrong anukunna… eppudu change avvaku.

And you have me… one text, and I will be present. I am always waiting just behind your back. 🤍🩹

But when you are sad or something happens… nenu untaa.

Nenu neeku first person avvali… whatever the matter, anything, I will be there!

I WILL BE THE FIRST PERSON TO OPEN ARMS FOR YOU. 🫂🤍

Remember that… and don't feel you are not worthy. Everything I put, you deserve. I feel like you are worthy of even moreee, and I will keep putting more efforts!
